entries: Nobody uses first names. Last names, nicknames, and titles are fine
Nobody starts a sentence with 'so' or 'well'
Nobody says 'um,' 'uh,' 'like,' or 'you know'
Nobody verbally agrees with anything. Nod, thumbs up, or stay quiet
Nobody interrupts. Wait for a full stop before you talk
Nobody repeats a word or phrase someone else just used
Nobody whispers. All communication must be at normal speaking volume or louder
Everyone speaks at half volume
Nobody uses contractions. Say 'do not' not 'don't,' 'I am' not 'I'm'
No swearing
No laughing out loud. Silent reactions only
Nobody gives a one-word answer. At least three words or it counts as a breach
Nobody makes a declarative statement. Everything must be a question or a non-answer
Everyone counts to three silently before speaking
Nobody says 'I don't know.' Commit to an actual answer
Nobody checks their own phone
Nobody laughs at their own joke
Nobody touches their face
Nobody fidgets. Tapping, leg bouncing, and pen clicking all count
No hand gestures while speaking. Hands stay still
When you speak, make eye contact with the person you're talking to. Look away and that's a breach
The phone passes with two hands only. One hand counts as a breach
Nobody crosses their arms
